intro.text: Amy Raupp grew up in Three Village, graduated from Ward Melville High School and still lives here with her husband and two sons. She earned her law degree in 2009 and runs Raupp Law from Carlton Avenue in Setauket, helping families across Nassau and Suffolk with estate planning, elder law and Medicaid, estate administration, guardianships, real estate and business law. Consultations are free, and she will come to your home.
intro.quote: You worked hard for your assets... we work hard to protect them.
